78469.subject: 🖱️ Claude got the biggest upgrade ever
78469.body:
----------
######           [Subscribe](https://academynews.genai.works/)   -    [Collaborate with us](https://utm.genai.works/r/cq9vsh4)


--------------------
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Claude can now use your Mac while you work on something else. On the same day Google shipped a $0.75 model that beats Opus 5 on 9 of 16 tests, the New York Stock Exchange told Congress that Claude found massive vulnerabilities and Meta caught up to the frontier.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Anthropic:** What can Claude do on your Mac while you're not looking?

* **Google:** Where does the cheap Gemini beat Opus 5 and where does it get crushed?

* **NYSE:** What did Claude find inside the stock exchange?

* **Meta:** Is the two-lab race over?


----------







----------
## Claude got the biggest upgrade ever

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/0e8202ef-4c40-4bcc-8c0c-cab865e3ec22/Sep_3_-_1.jpg?t=1788427496)
Caption: 

Claude can now [use your Mac in the background](https://x.com/claudeai/status/2095226833293685100). Since March you had to watch it drive your screen. Now it clicks, types and opens apps on its own while you work in another window.

* It doesn't touch your mouse or keyboard and waits if you're mid-typing.

* It tries a connector first, then its built-in browser, then your screen only if there's no other way.

* Trading and crypto apps are blocked by default and you can blocklist anything else.

It takes screenshots the whole time, so it sees everything on your screen. How comfortable you are with it depends on you. Beta, Pro and Max only, macOS 15 or later.

Turn it on in Settings → General → Computer use. OpenAI's Codex did this on the Mac first earlier this year. Anthropic finally matched it.


----------







----------
## Google's $0.75 model beats Opus 5

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/3ea891a9-5c45-4c7c-b34e-7045943b78a8/Sep_3_-_2.jpg?t=1788427507)
Caption: 

Google just shipped [Gemini 3.8 Flash](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/3-8-flash-and-3-8-flash-cyber/) , its third Flash in six weeks. Same price as 3.7 Flash, $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 output.

Google says it beats Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol on 9 of 16 benchmarks.

* 89.4% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, Opus 5 got 89.1%.

* 54.9% on HLE-Verified, best of the three.

* 19.1% on the harder Terminal-Bench 4.0, Opus 5 got 51.8%.

* 59% on OSWorld computer use, Opus 5 got 75.4%.

Google says it works harder on tough tasks, more reasoning
